query_original: Cuantos contratos se activaron esta semana?
confirmacion_mensaje: Entiendo que quieres saber la cantidad de tus contratos, específicamente los que se activaron esta semana. Por favor, confírmame si esto es correcto.
sql_generada: SELECT COUNT(*) from claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_raw.New_Contracts__c nc LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_raw.Contact c on  nc.Contracted_Agent__c = c.id LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_account_2 a on  a.Id = c.AccountId LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_cslb o ON nc.Carrier_State_line_of_Business__c = o.Id LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_claro.carrier_company cc ON cc.Id = o.Carrier__c LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_raw.Opportunity op on nc.Opportunity__c = op.Id where cc.Internal_Company_Object__c = 'a081G00000C9sU8QAJ' and (nc.Opportunity__c is NULL or (op.StageName not in  ('Canceled', 'Roll back')) ) AND a.Name_Agencies = 'Alliant Insurance Group' AND nc.Status__c IN ('Active', 'Active pending GA','JIT','Pending',' Pending release') AND DATE_TRUNC(DATE(nc.CreatedDate), WEEK) = DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), WEEK)
llm_respuesta:
Esta semana se activaron 0 contratos.
Si deseas ver el desglose por carrier, estado o línea de negocio, te invito a reformular tu pregunta. También puedes encontrar el detalle de tus contratos en el módulo CONTRACTS, dentro de la sección Agency Portfolio o a través del link https://arc.claroinsurance.com/contracts/portfolio-agency.

sql_generada: SELECT o.Carrier, o.State, o.Line_Of_Business, nc.Status__c, COUNT(*) as Cantidad, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() as Total_General from claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_raw.New_Contracts__c nc LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_raw.Contact c on  nc.Contracted_Agent__c = c.id LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_account_2 a on  a.Id = c.AccountId LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.claro_bi.dim_cslb o ON nc.Carrier_State_line_of_Business__c = o.Id LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_claro.carrier_company cc ON cc.Id = o.Carrier__c LEFT JOIN claroinsurance-dataplatform.salesforce_raw.Opportunity op on nc.Opportunity__c = op.Id where cc.Internal_Company_Object__c = 'a081G00000C9sU8QAJ' and (nc.Opportunity__c is NULL or (op.StageName not in  ('Canceled', 'Roll back')) )  AND a.Name_Agencies = 'Alliant Insurance Group' AND FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', nc.CreatedDate) = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) GROUP BY o.Carrier, o.State, o.Line_Of_Business, nc.Status__c QUALIFY SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() = 49
